{{Quote|Borg, ol' buddy... you just bought yourself a last resting-place.|Han Solo|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>}}
A '''cyborg''' was a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who [[Death/Legends|perished]] on [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] had [[Color/Legends|light]] skin and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and cybernetics covered the left side of his body. He had a small sack of coins on him when he died. After his death, [[Pera]] attempted to bury him in accordance with the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]] in [[Spacer's Hill]], but was unable to do so due to the bigotry against [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] intervened to [[Skirmish on Aduba-3|rescue]] Pera. Pera asked them to bury the cyborg themselves. After accepting the job to bury him, the two smugglers traveled through town but faced opposition from the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. With the help of Pera, they fought off the brawlers and were finally able to lay the cyborg to rest in Spacer's Hill.

==Behind the scenes==
This cyborg appears in the Marvel comic [[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]] The comic was the first original Marvel comic after the six issues which covered [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]''.
